# Real third-party source lines that reach a GATED assignment arm.
#
# The boundary filter's job is reading OTHER PEOPLE'S code through a
# filesystem server, and this repository's own sources are not a
# representative corpus for that. A round of changes that corrupted 119 lines
# of installed TypeScript showed zero regressions when swept over this repo's
# own 142 tracked files, and the suite stayed green, because 11 of its 12
# "source code delivered intact" cases have values too short to reach a gated
# arm at all.
#
# Every line below is verbatim from a package in node_modules, is matched by
# the affixed or camelCase arm's NAME shape with a value long enough to clear
# its gate — so its fate depends entirely on the shape rules — and crosses the
# boundary unchanged today. Any rule change that rewrites one fails CI.
#
# Sampled from: @eslint-community/eslint-utils, @eslint/plugin-kit,
# @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @noble/hashes, @types/node,
# @typescript-eslint/*, @vitest/*, acorn, bl, content-disposition,
# content-type, es-module-lexer, eslint, espree, expect-type, hono, jose,
# path-to-regexp, postcss, type-is, typescript, vite, vitest, yaml, zod.
# Their licences are their own; these are short declaration lines quoted as
# test data. Regenerate by sampling node_modules the same way.
#
